about: Risk floor per issue for remediation.route_issue (JOV-7706). Route costs and capabilities live on each lane's `routes` in providers.json. Frontier = protected surfaces (JOV-7343 blast radius) and company-OS orchestration (JOV-7701); bounded = frozen plans and mechanical work.

bindings.about: Extra Linear team -> repo bindings run by the one lanes service (scripts/lanes/bindings.py). Jovie (JOV, LANES_REPO, lane gate) is the implicit default. Active on `hosts` or wherever LANES_REPO_<KEY> points at a checkout; LANES_BINDING_<KEY>=0 turns one off. Tim 2026-10-11: any Todo issue is eligible (empty `requiredLabels`; only `excludedLabels` and the harness hard exclusions hold work back) and no run waits on a plan approval. LYB shares the host seats with no open-PR ceiling, opens a ready PR then moves the issue to In Review; LYB's own required checks and native merge queue land it.
